stage: V39: sufficient public state for executable continuation
frozen_before: Any V39 conditional-world execution or online replay. Read-only census uses all existing 148 V38 state menus and saved traces.
fixed: All V38 model parameters, V36 single-message conditioning, menus, 72 physical roots, legitimate information streams, MCT, deadlines, 128 conditional worlds and original assigned seeds. No new scientific samples.

definitions.v38: Unchanged V38 FastPlanner and complete SnapshotExecutor, shared across both actions.
definitions.fullmemo: V38 plus memoization of the current public decision using the original node and complete ordered raw public history. No future outcome is memoized.
definitions.frontier: Current onboard node projected to its current arrival and later exits. At a platform delete only publicly seen but no longer visible root candidates, retaining all visible and unseen candidates. Public decision key retains all ordered hard evidence, raw forecasts and service notices for every trip in the remaining recursive menu, including a departed root trip that reappears in another retained tail. Retain entry/ready/visible/clock and seen restricted to retained roots. Same current-decision memoization as fullmemo.

information_boundary: Retain the actual full execution path and full received history. Do not remove active-trip old observations, off-grid projection evidence or unselected forecasts that may later become selected. Platform retirement requires a public departure receipt and absence from the current visible set; schedule or prediction times never justify removal. No future world enters a decision key or policy. Same public decision may share its action; different worlds still execute their own future and retain distinct losses/statuses.
pre_execution_amendment: Before any V39 real conditional-world execution, source inspection confirmed all declared waiting rules exclude seen-minus-visible root offers. Include this exact platform retirement in the same frontier variant; no additional variant, sample or outcome-driven amendment.
sampling_boundary: TripWorlds receives the original complete node paths and original sorted trip list; deleting a trip would change the same-seed random tape. Projection is applied only when evaluating public decisions after sampling.
state_budget: Exactly one cold complete evaluation for each variant on all 148 original states: 444 measurements. Original 128 worlds re-executed; no new seed, omitted negative state, sample refinement or repeated timing selection. Preserve every completed receipt and all unresolved outcomes.
online_budget: Exactly one full online replay for each variant on all 72 roots: 216 controls. Every onboard gate computes its values online. The V38 state/seed-only manifest assigns original streams; old answers are used only after measurement for equivalence validation. An unknown public state stops this exact-replacement experiment.
cheap_budget: Run all six existing cheap controls once per root with V38 implementation and once with the frontier decision implementation: 864 deterministic controls. Both are declared now, so ordinary cheap baselines are not weakened by new key overhead, and they receive the same structural implementation if useful. Report all twelve; no per-root best-method oracle.
correctness: Every world loss/status/action trace/decision count, all unresolved-outcome bounds and selected gate actions must equal V38. All 72 physical outcomes and complete public action histories must match their originals. Retain all four wins, two harms and sixty-six ties against each cheap controller.
structural_measurement: Compare frontier with fullmemo as well as V38. Record public decision queries, unique evaluations and cache hits; active-trip/history sizes; removed past exits; actual ride/platform/kernel compilations. A smaller key alone or faster ordinary memoization is not structural computational benefit.
retention_rule: Retain this reduction as a useful structural implementation only if exactness holds, frontier performs fewer necessary unique decisions or subproblem compilations than fullmemo, and its aggregate fully charged CPU is lower than both fullmemo and V38 in the all-state panel and complete online replay. Report every slower case and the median paired cost. This is an engineering retention rule, not a significance or novelty test.
closure_rule: If the structural retention rule fails, close this sufficient-state remedy and the current algorithm-extension route. Keep V38, useful ordinary-memo engineering, positive/negative cases and the negative structural finding. Do not respond by adding variants, fitting filters, expanding DP, reducing samples or proposing another certificate in this stage.
timing: Sequential execution, BLAS threads=1; deterministic rotation of methods by state/root. Each variant has fresh model/history/planner/decision cache. Include key construction, lookup, cache maintenance, state statistics, all conditioning/sampling/continuation work and actual action processing. Online seed-manifest loading is charged; common input/graph preparation and output serialization are separate. Use current paired timings, not old V38 accounting as a speed denominator.
scope: Standard rollout is unchanged. Exactness refers to the original finite-bank executable estimator, not population integration or a future-message optimum. All dates remain development data. No server transfer. No claim of G2 completion follows automatically from this retention rule.
